facts.fact: La Nation reports the Interior Ministry launched the Mobile ID project with TO7 Network, giving citizens a secure digital identifier and an electronic certificate, led jointly by the National Cybersecurity Authority and the population directorate, with pilot phases planned before wide rollout.

systems.tiers: digital identifier and electronic certificate; legal framework pending

DJI.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Only a ministry assurance on data handling; no law, authority or decision is named.
The article says e-signature use awaits a finalised legal framework; no law or draft is named.
Online services are described as future, once the legal framework is final.
No count of people holding a national ID.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates the national ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.
A dematerialised biometric ID card is only a future aim; no ID system in service is described.
Public consultations are only planned, none is stated as held.
